map.锁定范围（Δf = K_v · V_max） 使用指南: Lock Range (delta_f = K_v * V_max) User Guide
map.输入压控振荡器增益 Kv 与控制电压范围，按 Δf = Kv·V_max 计算: Enter the VCO gain Kv and the control voltage range and compute the PLL lock (frequency pull-in) range with delta_f = Kv*V_max, used for capture bandwidth design.
map.锁相环中压控振荡器的频率牵引范围由增益与控制电压决定。: In a phase-locked loop, the frequency pull-in range of the voltage-controlled oscillator is set by the gain and the control voltage.
map.VCO 增益 Kv × 最大控制电压 Vmax 得捕获/锁定频偏范围。: VCO gain Kv x maximum control voltage Vmax gives the capture or lock frequency offset range.
map.锁相环可跟踪的频率跨度测算。: Estimate the frequency span a phase-locked loop can track.
map.对比不同 Kv 的锁定能力。: Compare the locking capability of different Kv values.
map.：锁定频偏 Δf = 1e6 × 5 = 5×10⁶ Hz = 5 MHz，即中: Lock frequency offset delta_f = 1e6 x 5 = 5e6 Hz = 5 MHz, meaning the circuit can lock within +/-5 MHz of the center frequency.
map.：若 Vmax=2V，则 Δf=2MHz，控制范围收窄，需更高 Kv 补偿。: If Vmax = 2V then delta_f = 2 MHz, narrowing the control range and requiring a higher Kv to compensate.
map.由中心频率与带宽求品质因数: Quality factor from center frequency and bandwidth
map.由有效值与负载求功率: Power from RMS value and load
map.锁定范围与捕获范围一样吗？: Are the Lock and Capture Ranges the Same?
map.通常捕获范围小于锁定（保持）范围，启动入锁要求更苛刻。: The capture range is usually smaller than the lock (hold) range, so acquiring lock at startup demands more margin.
map.Kv 越大越好吗？: Is a Larger Kv Always Better?
map.Kv 大可锁范围宽，但易受噪声与漂移影响，需环路滤波配合。: A large Kv gives a wide lock range, but it is sensitive to noise and drift, so loop filtering is needed.
